About this Event

Blue Glove Presents: KRITI SANON LIVE — BEYOND THE SCREEN @ Rayleigh Underground | DALLAS 2026
THE BIGGEST BOLLYWOOD STAR EXPERIENCE OF THE YEARGet ready for an extraordinary evening with Kriti Sanon, one of the biggest Bollywood stars of our time. With 50+ movies and 500+ songs shaping the world of Indian cinema, Kriti has captivated millions with her talent, charisma, iconic performances, and undeniable star power.
But this time, we’re bringing you something different.

We’re bringing you Kriti Sanon — BEYOND THE SCREEN.
5 HOURS OF PARTY. 1 HOUR WITH THE SUPERSTAR ON STAGE. A NIGHT TO REMEMBER.
Go beyond the movies, beyond the glamour, and beyond the characters you’ve loved on screen. Get an exclusive glimpse into her journey, her Bollywood story, her most iconic moments, and the person behind the superstar.
This is not just a celebrity appearance. This is your chance to experience the world of Kriti Sanon, LIVE.

WHAT TO EXPECT ON STAGE
HER STORY. BEYOND THE SCREEN.
Go behind the scenes of her incredible journey through Bollywood. Hear her story, discover the experiences that shaped her career, and get a more personal look at the superstar you know and love.
HER ICONIC SCENES. LIVE ACTS.
Watch Kriti recreate some of her most memorable and beloved Bollywood scenes in a way you’ve never experienced before.
HER HIT SONGS. LIVE STEPS.
Feel the magic as Kriti brings her most popular numbers, including Mashaooka and Param Sundari, to life on stage.
UP CLOSE AND PERSONAL.
Get ready for spontaneous moments, audience interaction, candid conversations, and a special Q&A session where you get to hear directly from Kriti herself.
HER BOLLYWOOD STORY.
From memorable roles to career-defining moments, discover the journey behind the stardom, the stories behind the scenes, and the experiences that made Kriti the star she is today.
